newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal prosecutor brings EU fund fraud charges.
newsitem.headline: Portugal prosecutor brings EU fund fraud charges.

text.p: Portugal's public prosecutor has charged 73 individuals and 71 companies in the country's biggest fraud case involving European Union social funds.
The daily Publico reported on Friday that police had investigated 300 companies for involvement in a scam to obtain European Union training subsidies by drawing up false receipts.
The defendants have been charged with fraud and criminal conspiracy but it was not clear when the case would go to court.
Publico said the fraud, which took place between 1986 and 1989, amounted to at least seven billion escudos ($40 million).
There are some 200 EU fund fraud cases from the 1980s still making their way through Portuguese courts. ($1=173 pte)
